last.verdict: Revenue beat estimates and AbbVie raised its outlook again, lifting the stock modestly.

reasons.label: Outlook raised again
reasons.text: 2026 profit guidance lifted to $13.95–$13.99 from $13.76–$13.96, and the dividend rises 5.2%.

reasons.label: Revenue beat estimates
reasons.text: Sales of $17.4B (up 10.3%) topped the roughly $17.3B analysts expected.

reasons.label: Immunology drugs surging
reasons.text: Skyrizi grew 22.7% and Rinvoq 23.9%, more than offsetting Humira's 31% decline.

story: Over the last few reports, AbbVie has grown sales about 10% a year, driven by Skyrizi and Rinvoq. The July report brought a stock drop as the Apogee deal trimmed the outlook. This quarter, guidance rose again and the shares recovered a little.

history.verdict: Sales beat, but profit missed and the Apogee deal trimmed the yearly outlook.

reasons.label: Profit missed estimates
reasons.text: Adjusted EPS of $3.65 fell short of the roughly $3.71 analysts expected.

reasons.label: Profit outlook trimmed
reasons.text: 2026 EPS guidance cut to $13.87–$14.07, below the $14.12 consensus, on Apogee deal costs.

reasons.label: $10.9B Apogee deal
reasons.text: AbbVie agreed to buy Apogee for about $10.9 billion, adding $0.14 per share of dilution.
